title: Choose Zelefin's visual world
question: The roll assigned UHD Slipcover. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: UHD Slipcover
options.thesis: The library is a shelf of certified discs, not a streaming wall.
options.viewport: iPhone home: one full-bleed disc still as the featured title, DV / Atmos / Direct Play as foil stamps in one corner, a shelf of posters below.
options.risk: Reads as Criterion merch if the stamps become decoration instead of real playback truth.

raised.raise: Focus inverts the selected disc like a pressed card, and Back retraces the exact trail.
Chroma lives only on the certification fringe; chrome stays achromatic.
One corner stamp per title, never a pile of badges.

options.label: Focus Stage
options.thesis: The Apple TV home, rebuilt around whether this file can light the room.
options.viewport: iPhone home: large focused poster, system tab bar, a single tint on Play, format facts as quiet metadata under the title.
options.risk: Also the direction most native Apple media clients land on.

options.label: Terminal Bands
options.thesis: Get to playback as a chain of signed decisions, not a poster wall.
options.viewport: iPhone home: one yellow band with the next action (Continue Dune, 41 min left), gate-scale title, black Play, yellow reserved for wayfinding only.
options.case: Holds product clarity: connect, browse, and play become one signed next step. Loses identification: film collectors do not live in a concourse.
options.risk: Yellow in a dark living room reads as an airport app if the stills never take the room.

options.label: Ceefax Index
options.thesis: The catalog is a live index: cyan figures for HDR and Atmos, yellow for titles, black for the room.
options.viewport: iPhone home: P100 header, yellow title row, cyan live chips (DV, Atmos, Direct Play) as the only status language.
options.case: Holds clarity for the mechanism: range and audio are live figures, not badges. Loses identification against a disc shelf.
options.risk: Reads as retro novelty the moment the 40-column lattice slips.

options.label: Quoted Path
options.thesis: Playback path is a physical tag: DIRECT PLAY stays on the disc, TRANSCODE gets the hazard stripe.
options.viewport: iPhone home: quoted zone labels, orange zip-tie on the playing title, 45-degree stripe only on titles that must transcode.
options.case: Holds clarity: Direct Play versus transcode is a physical fact. Loses identification: this is a warehouse, not a home theater.
options.risk: Quoted labels and hazard stripes fight Apple HIG on tvOS if they replace focus rings.

options.label: Shoebox Stack
options.thesis: Every title is a card you inspect in place.
options.viewport: A black-and-white card per title, invert on press, Back as the trail.
options.case: Loses both axes: Apple TV owners do not identify with HyperCard, and author-mode fights Operate.
options.kept: Invert-on-focus and an exact back trail.
options.risk: One-bit chrome cannot carry HDR stills.

options.label: Iridescent Fringe
options.thesis: HDR is a spectral fringe on an otherwise white field.
options.viewport: Wide white margins, stills edged with a narrow spectral band when Vision is present.
options.case: Loses both axes: a light pastel field is the wrong living-room scene, and poetry hides the play action.
options.kept: Color confined to a narrow fringe.
options.risk: White ground at night on a TV is glare.

options.label: Flash Scrawl
options.thesis: Navigation is another mark on a defaced still.
options.viewport: A crushed-shadow still with a marker title and one fluorescent corner sticker.
options.case: Loses both axes: club sleeves are not a film library, and defacement as chrome fights HIG.
options.kept: One corner stamp, never a badge row.
options.risk: Marker type is unreadable at 10-foot tvOS distance.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Infuse and Swiftfin played straight: dark poster rows, Continue Watching, system tabs, native player.
canonCard.viewport: Home with Continue Watching, Next Up, and library rows, executed at full Apple HIG craft.
